integration_issues.issue: BUG-005 NOT FIXED. Clicking post-add-reflection → entering text → thought-save creates a DUPLICATE highlight (count 1→2) AND the reflection is NOT attached to the original highlight. Observed live: target.thoughts == []. Root cause: (a) post-add-reflection onClick at Reader.jsx line 505 calls setPostCreateHighlight(null) BEFORE opening thoughtSheet, destroying the reference; (b) thought-save at line 577 hardcodes onClick={() => saveHighlight(true)} which always POSTs to /api/highlights creating a new row. The newly added saveReflectionOnExisting() function (line 222) is never invoked.

Same pattern partially broken at lines 540-545 / 602. post-save-word clears postCreateHighlight before opening vocab sheet, so the ternary at line 602 ALWAYS routes to saveVocab() — never saveVocabFromPost(). Net behavior: vocabulary still persists (no duplicate highlight created, because saveVocab only POSTs to /vocabulary), so end-user impact is minimal; but the dead code path indicates the same architectural flaw.

action_items: FIX BUG-005: Either (a) stop clearing postCreateHighlight in the post-add-reflection onClick at Reader.jsx lines 502-507 AND change thought-save onClick to: () => (postCreateHighlight ? saveReflectionOnExisting() : saveHighlight(true)); OR (b) call saveReflectionOnExisting() directly from the post-add-reflection button after capturing a default empty reflection. Simplest fix: change line 577 to `onClick={() => (postCreateHighlight ? saveReflectionOnExisting() : saveHighlight(true))}` AND remove `setPostCreateHighlight(null)` from line 505 (keep the highlight ref until after save).

FIX vocab path similarly: remove setPostCreateHighlight(null) from line 543 so the ternary at line 602 actually routes to saveVocabFromPost() (which attaches book_id/page from the highlight). saveVocabFromPost should also clear postCreateHighlight at the end.

Add a regression test in Playwright using the technique from iteration_3 (generate real PDF with reportlab, set localStorage cosift_token, navigate to /read/:bookId, use Range API + selectionchange event to trigger toolbar).
critical_code_review_comments: Reader.jsx line 502-507 clears the highlight reference (setPostCreateHighlight(null)) BEFORE the user has a chance to attach a reflection — defeats the purpose of saveReflectionOnExisting().
Reader.jsx line 577 thought-save handler is hardcoded to saveHighlight(true) — should branch on postCreateHighlight presence like the vocab-save handler at line 602 does.

The newly added helpers saveReflectionOnExisting() (line 222) and saveVocabFromPost() (line 245) are well-written but currently dead code paths because their callers clear postCreateHighlight prematurely.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend route is /read/:bookId (NOT /reader/). To exercise PDF text selection in Playwright: (1) generate a real PDF with reportlab; (2) POST /api/auth/anonymous → save token; (3) POST /api/books multipart with the PDF; (4) page.goto(BASE), localStorage.setItem('cosift_token', token), page.goto(`${BASE}/read/${bookId}`), wait ~6s for pdf.js; (5) document.querySelectorAll('.react-pdf__Page__textContent span') — pick one, create Range, addRange to window.getSelection(), dispatch new Event('selectionchange') on document; (6) wait 800ms for the debounce; toolbar will appear with data-testid='action-highlight'. After each user action ALWAYS count GET /api/books/{book_id}/highlights to detect duplicate-highlight regressions.
rca_of_the_issue: BUG-005 root cause is a state-management ordering bug in Reader.jsx, NOT a missing endpoint. The backend endpoint POST /api/highlights/{id}/thoughts works perfectly (verified via 3 pytest cases). The new client helper saveReflectionOnExisting() also looks correct. However, the post-action sheet's post-add-reflection button onClick clears postCreateHighlight before transitioning to thoughtSheet (line 505: setPostCreateHighlight(null)), and the thought-save button at line 577 unconditionally calls saveHighlight(true) (which creates a new highlight). So clicking 'Add Reflection' from the post-action sheet always: (1) creates a duplicate highlight; (2) attaches the reflection to the duplicate, not the original. Reproduction in test: after action-highlight click count was 1; after thought-save count became 2, and the original highlight's thoughts[] array remained empty. Mitigation: see action_items #1 — branch thought-save handler on postCreateHighlight and stop nulling it prematurely.
